sourceRecord.sourceWikitext:
{{Recipe summary
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 24 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. ¼-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (0.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) French [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] baguette slices
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (about 90 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (140 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) chopped [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]]
* 1 tbsp (15 ml) [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* 4 oz (140 g) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], room temperature
* 1 [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]], cut into 24 [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]]
* 8 oz (280 g) chilled [[Cookbook:Brie Cheese|brie]] cheese, trimmed and sliced into 24 pieces
* 24 pecan halves

== Procedure ==
# Place baguette slices on [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]] and [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] with melted butter. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 8 minutes or until golden brown in a [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|400°F (250°C)]] [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. Remove and allow to cool. 
# Blend pecans and oil in [[Cookbook:Food Processor|processor]] or [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] to smooth paste. Season with salt. 
# Spread cream cheese on toasted bread, then top with apple slices and brie slices.
# Spread pecan butter over top of each one. Top with pecan half.
# Place back on cookie sheet, and bake until cheese melts slightly (about 1 minute).
# Serve and enjoy.
